# Third-party licenses

<!-- Generated by `pnpm licenses:update` (tools/license-check) from tools/license-check/inventory.yaml,
     pnpm-lock.yaml, the image license reports and the exception files. Do not edit by hand:
     `pnpm license:check` fails when this file is stale. -->

Kobe is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)); attribution notices of
bundled components are in [NOTICE](NOTICE). This file lists every third-party component Kobe
uses, ships, or depends on at runtime. The policy (MIT/Apache/BSD/MPL family; anything else
needs a version-pinned exception that Chris signs off) is in
[docs/licensing.md](docs/licensing.md).

How used: **linked** (imported by Kobe code), **bundled** (shipped inside a Kobe image),
**separate process** (a program Kobe runs or talks to, not linked), **optional** (off by
default), **external** (operated by the site, not shipped by Kobe), **dev-only** /
**test-only** (never shipped).

## Pending gate review

Nothing is pending: every component outside the allowed family has Chris's approval.

## Web and services: npm packages (pnpm workspace)

Every package in pnpm-lock.yaml (production and development, all platforms). "linked, bundled" packages are in the production dependencies of a deployable and ship in its image (the services via `pnpm deploy --prod`, web via the Next.js standalone output, kobe-sandbox-agent in the sandbox image); "dev-only" packages build, lint and test Kobe and are never shipped. Checked by `pnpm license:check` (CI `checks`).

924 packages, 637 of them shipped in an image.

- `argparse` 2.0.1 (Python-2.0): Pulled in by js-yaml (via @kubernetes/client-node). PSF-2.0 is a permissive BSD-style license, not copyleft or source-available (KOBE-6). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `caniuse-lite` 1.0.30001814 (CC-BY-4.0): Browser-compatibility data table required by Next.js/browserslist at build time; an attribution-only data license, not copyleft or source-available (KOBE-5 review). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `khroma` 2.1.0 (Unknown): CSS colour helpers pulled in by mermaid (KOBE-130). The MIT license is in the repository and its npm metadata, but package.json has no license field, so a fresh pnpm store reports Unknown. Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.

## Sandbox image: Python and npm packages

What `images/sandbox/collect-licenses.sh` finds in the sandbox image (`kobe-sandbox`): the Python data stack (`images/sandbox/requirements.txt`), Pi and its dependencies (`images/sandbox/pi/package-lock.json`), kobe-sandbox-agent's production dependencies and the npm CLI. The committed report is `images/sandbox/third-party-licenses.json`; CI `sandbox-image` compares it with the built image and runs the policy check on it.

Documented exceptions (`images/sandbox/license-exceptions.json`):

- `asttokens` 3.0.2 (Apache 2.0): Apache-2.0 declared with a non-SPDX label (the package's own LICENSE is Apache-2.0); a dependency of IPython for the notebook kernel (KOBE-464). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-23.
- `matplotlib` 3.11.2 (Python-2.0): matplotlib's PSF-based license: permissive, not copyleft. Required for chart artifacts (the charts skill, spec D21) (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `npm` 12.2.1 (Artistic-2.0): The npm CLI, shipped unmodified as a separate program so agents can install packages through the egress proxy. Artistic-2.0 is OSI-approved and not copyleft for unmodified redistribution (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `pillow` 13.0.0 (MIT-CMU): HPND/MIT-CMU: permissive, MIT-like. matplotlib dependency (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `qrcode-terminal` 0.12.0 (Apache 2.0): Apache-2.0 declared with a non-SPDX label (npm dependency) (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `spdx-exceptions` 2.5.0 (CC-BY-3.0): SPDX exception-list data used by npm; attribution-only data license, not copyleft (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.
- `typing_extensions` 4.16.0 (PSF-2.0): Python Software Foundation license: permissive (BSD-style), not copyleft. Transitive dependency of the data stack (KOBE-21). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-17.

Documented exceptions (`images/orbit-eval/license-exceptions.json`):

- `agent-client-protocol` 0.12.1 (UNKNOWN): No license metadata, but the wheel ships the Apache License 2.0 text (dist-info/licenses/LICENSE, authors at apache.org). Inspect AI dependency (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `aiohappyeyeballs` 2.7.1 (Python-2.0): PSF-2.0 (the PyPI classifier maps to Python-2.0): permissive, not copyleft. aiohttp dependency (Inspect AI) (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `multidict` 6.7.1 (Apache License 2.0): Apache-2.0 declared as a free-text label (LICENSE file is the Apache 2.0 text). aiohttp dependency (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `pathlib_abc` 0.5.2 (Python-2.0): PSF-2.0 license text in the wheel: permissive, not copyleft. universal_pathlib dependency (Inspect AI) (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `regex` 2026.7.10 (Apache-2.0 AND CNRI-Python): Apache-2.0 with code under the CNRI Python license (BSD-like, permissive, GPL-compatible, not copyleft). tiktoken/Inspect AI dependency (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `tiktoken` 0.13.0 (MIT License): MIT, declared with the full license text in the License field instead of an SPDX id. Inspect AI dependency (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.
- `typing_extensions` 4.16.0 (PSF-2.0): Python Software Foundation license: permissive (BSD-style), not copyleft. Transitive dependency of pydantic/Inspect AI. Same exception as the sandbox image (KOBE-92). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-04.

## External skill scanner image: Python packages

What the same script finds in the optional external skill scanner image (`kobe-skill-scan`, KOBE-341): Cisco skill-scanner 2.2.1 (Apache-2.0) with the dependencies of its hashed lock exported without extras and without pcodedmp (`images/skill-scan/requirements.txt`, `scanner-requirements.txt`); its bundled CEL helper is the `skill-scan-cel-go` row. The image runs only when a Site admin turns the external scanner on, as a Job with no network. The committed report is `images/skill-scan/third-party-licenses.json`; CI `skill-scan-image` compares it with the built image.

91 packages, 91 of them shipped in an image.

- `tiktoken` 0.12.0 (MIT License): MIT declared with the license text instead of an SPDX id (approved for 0.13.0 in the Orbit eval image). litellm dependency (KOBE-341). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-20.
- `typing_extensions` 4.15.0 (PSF-2.0): Python Software Foundation license: permissive, not copyleft (approved for 4.16.0 in the Orbit eval image) (KOBE-341). Approved by Chris on 2026-10-20.

## Chart and cluster components

What the Helm chart deploys or needs on the cluster, and the services it talks to. None of these are linked into Kobe's code. S3-compatible storage, SMTP, the audit SIEM and the OpenTelemetry backend are services the site operates (chart values `s3`, `smtp`, `auditForwarding`, `telemetry`); Kobe ships none of them. ## Assets (icons and fonts)

The web UI ships no font files (it uses the system font stacks) and no images; its icons come from lucide-react (in the npm table). Fonts reach the sandbox image only inside Python packages, which use them to render charts and PDFs.
